simple.meaning: שָׁלוֹם (shâlôwm) appears 237 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line and in connection with flocks.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 6 more, beginning at Genesis 15:15. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, flock.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁלוֹם (H7965) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שָׁלוֹם through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: שָׁלוֹם (shâlôwm) / H7965 is tracked through Genesis 15:15, Genesis 26:29, Genesis 26:31, Genesis 28:21. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
